limits: Finite loopback process/replication-network faults, not powerloss, disk durability, throughput benchmarking or arbitrary distributed failures.
No distributed transaction or exactly-once business-effect claim.
Ack1 loss means the clean new leader lacks E01; the offline former leader still physically contains E01, explicitly preserved in snapshots.
Healthy ack1 was later observed on all three replicas; this does not mean ack1 required three copies at the moment it replied.
The test proves its gated cases and configurations; it does not claim every production failure has the same outcome.
This is runtime evidence, not animation/teaching-model output, production media review or an independent code-review gate.
